BAKED CRACKERS: Our baked bunny crackers are made with organic wheat and made with real cheese from cows not treated with rBST

REAL INGREDIENTS: No artificial flavors, synthetic colors, or preservatives

CERTIFIED ORGANIC: Organic cheese from cows raised without antibiotics or synthetic hormones. Certified organic ingredients are grown without persistent pesticides

NON-GMO: We work with trusted suppliers to source only non-GMO ingredients

BOX CONTAINS: 1 box, 7.5 oz (Pack of 12)
features:
Features

Made with Real Organic Cheese

These crackers feature real white cheddar cheese made from organic milk, delivering an authentic and rich cheesy flavor.

Certified Organic & Non-GMO

Crafted with organic ingredients and free from genetically modified organisms, ensuring a clean and trustworthy snacking experience.

Fun Bunny Shapes

Their playful bunny-shaped design makes them appealing to kids, while still offering a flavor adults enjoy.

Baked, Not Fried

These crackers are oven-baked to golden perfection, giving a crunchy bite without the greasiness of fried snacks.

No Artificial Junk

Contains no artificial flavors, synthetic colors, preservatives, or high-fructose corn syrup.

Wholesome Ingredients List

Made with organic wheat flour, sunflower oil, and real cheddar cheese with a short, recognizable ingredient list.

Benefits

Family-Friendly Snack

Loved by both children and adults, making them a versatile addition to lunchboxes, after-school snacks, or on-the-go munching.

Peace of Mind for Parents

Organic and non-GMO certification means you can feel confident about what your family is eating.

Flavor Kids Crave

The sharp yet smooth cheddar flavor satisfies cheese-lovers and snackers alike.

Ideal for School Snacks

Meets many school snack standards and participates in Box Tops for Education programs.

Supports Clean Eating Lifestyles

Suitable for those avoiding artificial additives and looking for better-for-you snack choices.
ingredients: Organic Wheat Flour, Organic Expeller-Pressed Sunflower Oil, Organic Cheddar Cheese (pasteurized organic milk, cheese cultures, salt, non-animal enzymes), Organic Dried Cheddar Cheese (organic cultured milk, salt, non-animal enzymes), Organic Whey, Salt, Organic Nonfat Dry Milk, Organic Yeast, Leavening (monocalcium phosphate, baking soda), Organic Paprika, Organic Onion Powder, Organic Cane Sugar, Organic Celery Seed, Non-Animal Enzymes.
